Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 1-H at 1812-1814 W Grand

Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                     ORDINANCE



B E IT ORDAINED BY T H E CITY COUNCIL OF T H E CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the Bl-2 Neighborhood Shopping

District symbols as shown on Map No.    1-H

in the area bounded by:



The public alley next north of and parallel to West Grand Avenue; and a line 120 feet

west of and parallel to North Wood Street; West Grand Avenue; and a line 168 feet

west of and parallel to North Wood Street.



To those of a Bl-2 Neighborhood Shopping District, as amended




SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common address of property: 1812-14 West Grand Avenue, Chicago
  A N A R R A T I V E AND PLANS F O R T Y P E 1 ZONING A M E N D M E N T F O R
                    1812-14 WEST GRAND AVENUE, CHICAGO

The subject property is currently vacant. The City Council had previously rezoned this
property to its current Bl-2 District, as a Type 1 Application. Since that rezoning was
done more than 2 years ago, the Applicant needs this zoning change to substitute
previously approved Type 1 Plans. The Applicant intends to build a new 4-story mixed-
use building with commercial units on the ground door and 4 dwelling units on the upper
floors.

                                   Zoning Change from a Bl-2 Neighborhood
       Project Description:        Shopping District to a B1 -2 Neighborhood
                                   Shopping District, as amended

       Set Backs:                  Front Setback: 5"
                                   Side Setbacks: East: 3.5" / West: 4"
                                   Rear Setback (residential floors): 30.67'

       Building height:             43'-8"
